Shrimp Sauce Yum Yum Sauce
By: Wendi Spraker
Published: Sunday, December 7, 2014 - 4:58pm

Ingredients




2 Cups of Mayonnaise
½ Cup Ketchup
3 Tbs Sugar
1 Tbs Garlic Powder
1 Tbs Paprika
1 tsp onion powder
1 tsp salt
½ tsp cayenne pepper
½ Cup of water
1 tsp Siracha or other hot sauce.

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients in a bowl – may add extra sugar to taste. Allow to sit in refrigerator for at least an hour before serving so that flavors can meld.

About

This easy recipe for Shrimp Sauce Yum Yum Sauce from loavesanddishes.net is just like the sauce you love at your favorite Japanese Restaurant.
